sanskrit: utevāsy abandhukṛd utāsy anujāmikaḥ | uto kṛtyākṛtaṃ prajāṃ naḍam ivā chindhi vārṣikam ||
english: You are as one who severs kinship-bonds, and likewise one who undoes what is born of the same womb; moreover, cut down the progeny of the sorcerer as one cuts the monsoon reed.

sanskrit: brāhmaṇena paryukto 'si kaṇvena nārṣadena | senevaiṣi tviṣīmatī na tatra bhayam asti yatra prāpnoṣy oṣadhe ||
english: You have been consecrated by the Brāhmaṇa, by Kaṇva the son of Nṛṣad; you advance like an army charged with blazing energy — there is no fear wherever you arrive, O herb.

sanskrit: agre 'sy oṣadhīnāṃ jyotiṣevābhidīpayan | uta pākasya trātāsy uta hantāsi rakṣasaḥ ||
english: You are foremost among herbs, blazing forth like a light; you are both the protector of the simple-minded and the slayer of the Rakṣas.

sanskrit: yad ado devā asurāṃs tvayāgre nirakṛṇvata | tasmād adhi tvam oṣadhe apāmārgo ajāyathāḥ ||
english: When of old the gods drove out the Asuras with your aid, it was from that very act, O herb, that you, the Apāmārga, were born.

sanskrit: vibhindatī śataśākhā vibhindan nāma te pitā | pratyag vi bhindhi taṃ tvaṃ yo asmām̐ abhidāsati ||
english: Splitting asunder with a hundred branches — "Vibhindan" (the Splitter) is your father's name; split apart in turn the one who assails us.

sanskrit: asad bhūmyāḥ sam abhavat tad dyām eti bṛhad vacaḥ | tad it tato vidhūmayat pratyak kartāram ṛcchatu ||
english: What arose from the earth came into being; that great utterance ascends to heaven — let it, having driven away the evil like smoke, rebound and strike the one who wrought it.

sanskrit: pratyaṅ hi saṃbabhūvitha pratīcīnaphalas tvam | pratīcīḥ kṛtyā ākṛtya- -amuṃ kṛtyākṛtaṃ jahi ||
english: For you have come into being facing backward, you whose fruit points westward; having turned the sorceries back in the reverse direction, slay that one who wrought the sorcery.

sanskrit: śatena mā pari pāhi sahasreṇābhi rakṣa mā | indras te vīrudhāṃ pata ugra ojmānam ā dadhau ||
english: Guard me round about with a hundredfold protection, shield me on all sides with a thousandfold; Indra, the fierce lord of plants, has bestowed upon you his surging might.

sanskrit: arātyā dyāvāpṛthivī chintaṃ mūlam atho śiraḥ | vicchidya madhyataḥ pṛṣṭīs tāṃ kṛṇvāthām adhaspadam ||
english: O Heaven and Earth, cut off the root of Arātī (Grudging), and likewise her head; having severed her spine in the middle, make her something trodden underfoot.

sanskrit: idaṃ śṛṇu jātavedo yad amuṣyā vaco mama | arātyāḥ sarvam ic chiraḥ praśnaṃ vṛhatam aśvinā ||
english: Hear this, O Jātavedas, this word of mine directed against her; O Aśvins, crush utterly the whole head of Arātī.

sanskrit: yā svapnayā carati gaur bhūtvā janām̐ anu | arātim indra tvaṃ jahi tām agnir ivasā dahāt ||
english: She who roams by night having taken the form of a cow, moving among people — O Indra, slay that Arātī; let Agni burn her up utterly.

sanskrit: śreṣṭho me rājā varuṇo havaṃ satyena gacchatu | arātiṃ hatvā santokām ugro devo 'bhi dāsatu ||
english: May Varuṇa, my most excellent king, reach my invocation by means of truth; may the fierce god, having slain Arātī together with her offspring, bestow [good fortune] upon us.

sanskrit: deṣṭrī ca yā sinīvālī sapta ca śrotyā yāḥ | arātiṃ viśvā bhūtāni ghnantu dāsīm ivāgasi ||
english: Both Sinīvālī who assigns destinies and the seven who are worthy of hearing — may all beings smite Arātī as they smite a slave-woman who has transgressed.

sanskrit: somo rājauṣadhībhiḥ sūryācandramasā ubhā | arātiṃ sarve gandharvā ghnantv apsarasaś ca yāḥ ||
english: Soma the king with his herbs, and both the Sun and the Moon — may all the Gandharvas and all the Apsarases smite Arātī.

sanskrit: bhavo rājā bhavāśarvāv indro vāyur bṛhaspatiḥ | tvaṣṭā me adhyakṣaḥ pūṣā te 'rātiṃ ghnantu sarvadā ||
english: Bhava the king, Bhava and Śarva together, Indra, Vāyu, Bṛhaspati, Tvaṣṭṛ my overlord, and Pūṣan — may they smite that Arātī of yours at all times.

sanskrit: ye ca devā bhūmicarā ye cāmī divy āsate | ye antarikṣasyeśate te 'rātiṃ ghnantu savratāḥ ||
english: Those gods who roam the earth and those yonder who abide in heaven, those who hold sway over the atmosphere — may they all, united in their ordinance, smite Arātī.

sanskrit: yā ceṣitāsurair devebhir iṣitā ca yā | atho yā manyor jāyate 'rātiṃ hanmi brahmaṇā ||
english: She who is set in motion by the Asuras and she who is set in motion by the gods, and moreover she who is born of wrath — Arātī I smite with the sacred word (brahman).

sanskrit: tad in nu me acacchadan mahad yakṣaṃ bṛhad vapuḥ | viśvair yad devair nirṛtis tanā yujā saṃ mṛtyor iha jāyate ||
english: This has now been revealed to me: the great Yakṣa, the vast form — how Nirṛti, yoked together with all the gods as her allies, is born here in fellowship with Death.

sanskrit: amamriścitsāprathovadadahim ahirājantam ojasā | āyuṃ cit kutsam atithigvam ardaya vi nikilbindam ojasā ||
english: Even Amamriścit struck down, even Sāprathu spoke, burning the serpent that lorded it over like a king, with power; crush even Āyu, even Kutsa, even Atithigva; dispel Nikilbinda with power.

sanskrit: yāvatī dyāvāpṛthivī varimṇā yāvad vā sapta sindhavo mahitvā | tāvatī nirṛtir viśvavārā viśvasya yā jāyamānasya veda ||
english: As wide as Heaven and Earth in their breadth, as great as the seven rivers in their greatness — so great is Nirṛti, all-encompassing, she who knows all that is being born.

sanskrit: viśvasya hi jāyamānasya devi puṣṭasya vā puṣṭapatir babhūvitha | namo 'stu te nirṛte mā tv asmān parā bhujo nāparaṃ hātayāsi ||
english: For you have become the lord of the nourishment of all that is born, O goddess, or of what is fully nourished; reverence be to you, O Nirṛti — do not devour us, and do not cause any further loss.

sanskrit: devīm ahaṃ nirṛtiṃ manyamānaḥ piteva putraṃ na sace vacobhiḥ | viśvasya yā jāyamānasya veda śiraḥśiraḥ prati sūro 'nu tasthe ||
english: Regarding Nirṛti as a goddess, I do not pursue her with words as a father pursues a son; she who knows all that is being born — the sun has followed head by head in her wake.

sanskrit: asunvantam ayajamānam iccha stenasyetyāṃ taskarasyānu śikṣa | svapantam iccha sā ta ityā namas tu te nirṛte 'haṃ kṛṇomi ||
english: Seek out one who does not press the Soma, who does not sacrifice; follow the path of the thief, pursue the robber; seek one who sleeps — that is your domain; reverence I hereby make to you, O Nirṛti.

sanskrit: asunvakān nirṛtiḥ saṃjighatsur nāsyāḥ pitā vidyate nota mātā | madhyāt svasrām anu jaghāna sarvaṃ na devānām asuryaṃ sam āpa ||
english: Nirṛti, eager to devour those who do not press the Soma — for her no father is known, nor any mother; she smote her own sister utterly in the very midst, yet she did not attain the lordly power of the gods.

sanskrit: yad asya pāre tamasaḥ śukraṃ jyotir ajāyata | tan naḥ parṣad ati dviṣo 'gne vaiśvānara dyumat ||
english: The bright light that was born beyond that darkness — may it, O Agni Vaiśvānara, luminously carry us across, beyond our enemies.
